description: Automated checks mapped to NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls. Checks with an 'odp' entry use organization-defined parameters: the value in the check is the default, and organizations can set their own value without editing this file.

rules.title: MFA enforced on all privileged accounts
rules.remediation: Enroll every enabled administrative account in phishing-resistant MFA and block privileged sign-in without it.

rules.title: MFA enforced on standard user accounts
rules.remediation: Roll out MFA to all standard users, starting with email and remote-access applications.

rules.title: Accounts inactive for more than {display} are disabled (ODP)
rules.remediation: Disable accounts with no sign-in for more than {display} and add a recurring access review.

odp.label: Days of inactivity before an account must be disabled

rules.title: No shared or generic user accounts
rules.remediation: Replace shared accounts with individually assigned accounts so every action is attributable to one person.

rules.title: Privileged accounts limited to {display} of enabled accounts (ODP)
rules.remediation: Review administrative group membership and remove rights that are not required for the job role.

odp.label: Maximum share of enabled accounts that may be privileged

rules.title: Account lockout after 1 to {display} failed attempts (ODP)
rules.remediation: Set the account lockout threshold to {value} or fewer consecutive failed sign-in attempts.

odp.label: Maximum failed sign-in attempts before lockout

rules.title: Minimum password length of {display} (ODP)
rules.remediation: Raise the minimum password length to at least {display} and allow passphrases.

rules.title: Device lock after {display} of inactivity or less (ODP)
rules.remediation: Apply a device lock policy of {display} or less through group policy or MDM.

odp.label: Maximum minutes of inactivity before the device locks

rules.title: Security event logging enabled on all systems
rules.remediation: Enable security event logging (authentication, privilege use, configuration changes) on every system.

rules.title: Audit logs retained for at least {display} (ODP)
rules.remediation: Extend log retention to at least {display} online, with longer archival where contracts or regulations require it.

rules.title: Audit logs reviewed at least every {display} (ODP)
rules.remediation: Assign an owner and review logs at least every {display}, or automate alerting for high-risk events.

odp.label: Maximum days between audit log reviews

rules.title: Centralized security monitoring in place
rules.remediation: Forward logs to a central platform (SIEM or managed detection service) with alerting on suspicious activity.

rules.title: Vulnerability scans run at least every {display} (ODP)
rules.remediation: Schedule authenticated vulnerability scans of all systems at least every {display}.

rules.title: Critical security patches applied within {display} (ODP)
rules.remediation: Patch critical vulnerabilities within {display}, prioritizing internet-facing systems and known-exploited vulnerabilities.

odp.label: Maximum days to apply critical patches

rules.title: No unsupported operating systems in use
rules.remediation: Upgrade or replace systems running end-of-life software; isolate any that cannot be replaced yet.

rules.title: Endpoint malware protection on workstations and servers
rules.remediation: Deploy and centrally manage endpoint protection (EDR or antivirus) on every workstation and server.

rules.title: No remote administration ports exposed to the internet
rules.remediation: Close SSH, Telnet, RDP, and VNC to the internet; require VPN with MFA for remote administration.

rules.title: Perimeter firewall uses default-deny
rules.remediation: Configure inbound firewall rules to deny by default and allow only documented business traffic.

rules.title: Encryption in transit uses TLS 1.2 or higher
rules.remediation: Disable SSL and TLS 1.0/1.1 and require TLS 1.2 or 1.3 on all services.

rules.title: Disk encryption on systems storing sensitive data
rules.remediation: Enable full-disk encryption (for example BitLocker or FileVault) on every system that stores sensitive data.

rules.title: Remote access requires VPN with MFA
rules.remediation: Require MFA on the VPN or remote-access gateway for every user.

rules.title: Backups performed at least every {display} (ODP)
rules.remediation: Schedule backups of critical systems and data at least every {display}.

rules.title: An offline or immutable backup copy exists
rules.remediation: Keep at least one backup copy offline or immutable so ransomware cannot encrypt or delete it.

rules.title: Backup restore tested within the last {display} (ODP)
rules.remediation: Perform and document a test restore of critical systems at least every {display}.

odp.label: Maximum days since the last backup restore test

rules.title: Incident response plan exists
rules.remediation: Write an incident response plan covering roles, contacts, escalation, and recovery steps.

rules.title: Incident response plan reviewed within the last {display} (ODP)
rules.remediation: Review and update the incident response plan annually and after any significant incident.

odp.label: Maximum days since the incident response plan was reviewed

rules.title: Security awareness training completion of {display} or more (ODP)
rules.remediation: Require annual security awareness training, including phishing, and follow up with non-completers.

rules.title: Baseline configurations are documented
rules.remediation: Document secure baseline configurations (for example CIS Benchmarks) for each system type.

rules.title: Unnecessary services are disabled
rules.remediation: Disable services that are not needed for the system's business function.
